clips.title: The story
paras: After Onyxia's fall, skilled leatherworkers in Orgrimmar learn how her scales can guard against the black dragonflight. Overlord Runthak recognizes their craft and teaches a rare technique for making protective cloaks, needed against the flames of Blackrock Spire.

Onyxia's fall is a triumph for the Horde, yet the black dragonflight remains a threat. The broodmother's scaled hide resists draconic flame. Horde leaders seek craftsmen who can turn the dragon's remains into defensive armor rather than let them go to waste.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A dragon slayer and a seasoned leatherworker? You do not cease to astonish, hero. I am humbled.
Please accept what I am about to teach you. This knowledge will prove to be invaluable if you are to destroy what remains of the Black Dragonflight.
Create the cloak from the scales of the brood mother. It will protect you and your allies against the incendiary breath of the Lord of Blackrock... Nefarian.
